fields.title: Deleting a book never erases your own file
fields.description: Fixes BUG-238 (HIGH): `delete-doc` hard-unlinks the user's own file. Delete never unlinks: Blurby sends to the Recycle Bin only files it owns in its own data directory, and a book whose file lives in the user's folder loses its library entry only, with the file untouched (owner ruling #31, 2026-11-03). A removed folder book stays removed across rescans and tombstone purge.
fields.notes: origin: BUG-238 (Blurby.Brain1 trace, 2026-11-03); owner ruling #31 "Only remove from Blurby"; Brain1 technical ruling: `shell.trashItem` only, never unlink. Open for Brain1: the persisted-exclusion mechanism (spec recommends a device-local main-only settings key). Seq 89.5 by planner (data loss, risk first). Lands before LIBRARY-CONTENT-DEDUP-1 and AUTO-ARCHIVE-1 wave B.
